development_failures.reason: Default IPC requires missing CapnProto; disabled IPC consistently with prior qualification
CLI could not find event2/buffer.h because the initial cached pkg-config discovery lacked the extracted sysroot; corrected local cache and rebuilt unchanged source
--relay-transaction requires a minimum 60-second mining phase; 20 seconds was rejected before starting nodes

assumptions_requiring_independent_analys: Secure fresh production RNG and uncompromised endpoints
Two-contribution KEM combiner/AKE security under malicious active peers
Transcript/role/session separation beyond the enumerated finite traces, reflection and unknown-key-share models
Forward secrecy under later identity compromise, adequate erasure and no post-compromise-recovery claim
Native primitive and comparison side-channel behavior

not_executed_or_deferred.reason: Focused first-party adapter/lifecycle TSan only; no complete node TSan qualification
KEM combination, active-peer model, erasure and asynchronous acceptance require independent reviewer modeling judgment

residual_risks: Independent custom-AKE/combiner/forward-secrecy/reflection/unknown-key-share and side-channel review remains required

Windows persistent storage unsupported/fail-closed; POSIX unencrypted files assume trusted user, filesystem and ancestors
